en.text:
Class Ability usage drops a Parting Gift that explodes after 1.5 seconds, dealing <pve 440 /> <pvp [121] /> damage over a 7.5 meter radius.

Parting Gift applies an additional effect based on the element of your equipped Super Ability:
• <arc/>Arc: <arc/>Blind for <pve 10 /> <pvp [3] /> seconds
• <solar/>Solar: 40 <solar/>Scorch (60 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes)
• <stasis/>Stasis: <pve 40 /> <pvp [20] /> <stasis/>Slow Stacks for <pve 4 /> <pvp [1.5] /> seconds (<pve 8 /> <pvp [2] /> seconds with Whisper of Durance)
• <void/>Void: <void/>Suppression for 10 seconds <pvp [Does not apply to Guardians in their Super] />
• <strand/>Strand: <strand/>Sever for <pve 10 /> <pvp [5] /> seconds (<pve 15 /> <pvp [7] /> with <strand/>Thread of Continuity)

Detonates instantly on contact with a surface or an enemy (for instant detonations, try the 4pc Dark Age Set Bonus from Warlord's Ruin).
